scientific_integrity: The proof uses a complete finite Gaussian-integer rank certificate and analytic inference to all complex vectors. No independent review or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The finite exact certificate is specific to the canonical Pauli five-base system; the extension to all complete dimension-four systems relies on the published uniqueness classification.
This does not address incomplete families, other dimensions, or approximate zeros.
The full manuscript of the motivating odd-prime 2026 preprint was inaccessible; its abstract excludes even prime-power dimension four, but unindexed equivalent historical results remain possible.
title: Complete total-support spectrum and six-zero rigidity for five four-dimensional mutually unbiased bases
